related.title: OAuth 2.0 安全實務：PKCE 與權杖生命週期
related.titleEn: OAuth 2.0 security: PKCE and token lifecycles
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：六類案例結果一致且時效餘裕可重算；完整token與個人資料不寫入一般診斷日誌。 交付claim驗證矩陣、兩種時鐘設定及金鑰更新診斷流程。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All six cases produce expected outcomes and margins are reproducible; full tokens and personal data are excluded from ordinary diagnostic logs. Deliver the claim-validation matrix, two clock configurations and a key-rotation diagnostic flow.
related.difference: 用紙面序列圖串接授權碼、S256 PKCE challenge、verifier與token端點；在圖上標出state、精確redirect URI與refresh token輪替的不同功能。
related.differenceEn: Draw the authorization code, S256 PKCE challenge, verifier and token endpoint; distinguish state, exact redirect URI and refresh-token rotation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 驗證須固定可信 issuer 與允許演算法，再核對 audience、時效及流程要求；解碼 JSON 不等於驗證簽章。 教學 token 的exp=1200秒，驗證時刻1010秒，允許時鐘偏移30秒；本題只計時效上限餘裕。 exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220秒；偏移容忍改0後為190秒。
PKCE將授權碼兌換綁到verifier；若verifier由均勻隨機位元組產生，原始熵上限為8n位元，但不等於整個系統安全強度。 教學verifier來源為32個獨立均勻隨機位元組，再做無填補base64url編碼；不使用可預測時間戳。 原始熵32×8=256位元；48位元組版本為384位元。編碼長度分別43與64字元，編碼不創造額外熵。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Pin trusted issuer and allowed algorithms, then validate audience, time and flow-specific claims; decoding JSON does not verify a signature. A teaching token expires at 1200 seconds, verification occurs at 1010, and permitted clock skew is 30 seconds; calculate only the expiry upper-bound margin. exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220 seconds; with zero skew allowance, margin is 190 seconds.

PKCE binds code redemption to a verifier; n uniformly random bytes provide at most 8n bits of source entropy, not the strength of the entire system. The teaching verifier starts with 32 independent uniform random bytes and uses unpadded base64url, not predictable timestamps. Source entropy is 32×8=256 bits; 48 bytes provide 384 bits. Encoded lengths are 43 and 64 characters; encoding adds no entropy.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenSSH 憑證：短效存取與主體範圍
related.titleEn: OpenSSH certificates: short-lived access and principal scope
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：六類案例結果一致且時效餘裕可重算；完整token與個人資料不寫入一般診斷日誌。 交付claim驗證矩陣、兩種時鐘設定及金鑰更新診斷流程。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All six cases produce expected outcomes and margins are reproducible; full tokens and personal data are excluded from ordinary diagnostic logs. Deliver the claim-validation matrix, two clock configurations and a key-rotation diagnostic flow.
related.difference: 畫出管理者、簽發端、跳板與目標測試主機；區分主機身分驗證和使用者授權，為每張合成憑證列principal、有效期與序號。
related.differenceEn: Map administrator, signer, bastion and test host; distinguish host authentication from user authorization and list principal, validity and serial per synthetic certificate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 驗證須固定可信 issuer 與允許演算法，再核對 audience、時效及流程要求；解碼 JSON 不等於驗證簽章。 教學 token 的exp=1200秒，驗證時刻1010秒，允許時鐘偏移30秒；本題只計時效上限餘裕。 exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220秒；偏移容忍改0後為190秒。
登入時剩餘生命=TTL−簽發到使用的延遲；仍需符合principal與主機信任，剩餘時間大於零不是唯一准入條件。 教學憑證TTL60分鐘，簽發至登入延遲10分鐘；時鐘同步且無額外寬限。 60−10=50分鐘可用；TTL縮為30分鐘後剩20分鐘。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Pin trusted issuer and allowed algorithms, then validate audience, time and flow-specific claims; decoding JSON does not verify a signature. A teaching token expires at 1200 seconds, verification occurs at 1010, and permitted clock skew is 30 seconds; calculate only the expiry upper-bound margin. exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220 seconds; with zero skew allowance, margin is 190 seconds.

Remaining lifetime at login equals TTL minus issuance-to-use delay; principal and host trust must also match, so positive lifetime alone does not authorize access. Teaching TTL is 60 minutes and issuance-to-login delay 10 minutes, with synchronized clocks and no grace interval. 60−10=50 usable minutes; TTL 30 leaves 20 minutes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
